# Archived cylinder island document

`body-83d6bb1-cylinder-island.json` was generated by the compiled source of cadloom commit `83d6bb1`, before the shared quadratic point codec and sewing changes. It is a real version-1 construction document, not regenerated with the current decoder.

Construction: three Z-axis cylinders centered at the origin with squared radii 9, 4, 1 and axial intervals [-3,3], [-2,2], [-1,1]. Expression: outer minus (cavity minus island). The archived result contains 74 faces and three shells. The regression restores the archived document and checks incidence, region declarations and material truth against independent concentric-radius inequalities.
